use_case_summary: Bridgecrest is a mid-market contact-center platform aiming to add automated post-call summarization, QA scoring, and coaching highlight extraction. They want reliable summaries that can be converted to Zendesk tickets (tool-calls), low-latency generation for supervisor dashboards, and predictable performance under traffic spikes. High priority: per-region data residency, SSO/SAML, KMS encryption, and SOC2-level reporting.
